# EnterpriseGlue v0.27.6 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.27.5`.

## Highlights

- **release-and-packaging:** Centralizes published-package groups, dependency propagation, and chart version bindings in one validated release manifest.

## User and administrator impact

- Package and chart version mismatches are rejected before hosted release work starts.
- Developers receive one deterministic version plan instead of discovering follow-up package bumps across repeated CI runs.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Release publication remains protected and continues to promote only exact qualified artifacts.

## Documentation

- Documents the package-group manifest, generated version-plan workflow, dependency trains, and independent plugin release boundary.

## Known limitations

- The planner validates and explains package changes but does not choose semantic impact for an author.

## Rollback

- Revert the version-authority manifest and planner; existing immutable release receipts and published artifacts remain unchanged.

## Validation evidence

- Version-authority fixtures cover direct package changes, transitive packed-workspace consumers, semantic bumps, continuous release-range histories, chart bindings, and unrelated changes.
- CI contract tests verify that the package-discipline lane invokes the deterministic planner.

## Release metadata

- Release-note fragments: `package-version-authority`
- Audiences: developers, operators
- Compatibility: backward-compatible
